crossRefs.note: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”
Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of…
But, Yahweh of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for…
But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes.
Only know for certain that, if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on…
from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you…
Alexander, the coppersmith, did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds,
At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God…
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her…
But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
For the destroyer has come on her, even on Babylon. Her mighty men are taken. Their bows are broken in pieces, for…

people.name: Jehoiada
people.line: High priest who overthrew Athaliah and crowned Joash

people.name: Joash
people.line: King of Judah, son of Ahaziah

translations.web: Thus Joash the king didn’t remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he died, he said, “May Yahweh look at it, and repay it.”
translations.bsb: Thus King Joash failed to remember the kindness that Zechariah’s father Jehoiada had extended to him. Instead, Joash killed Jehoiada’s son. As he lay dying, Zechariah said, “May the LORD see this and call you to account.”
translations.kjv: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD look upon it, and require it.
translations.asv: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, Jehovah look upon it, and require it.
